items.question: What proportional measures are prescribed for the side hall at its front and back?
premises: The side hall is the structural element being measured.
The front and back are the specified locations for measurement.
The prescribed measures are a four-part measure and a six-part measure.
items.inference: The side hall is assigned a four-part measure and a six-part measure at its front and back.
uncertainties: The exact dimensional application of vedāṃśaṃ and ṣaḍaṃśaṃ to front versus back is not explicitly specified.
items.plain_english: The side hall, however, is to measure four parts and six parts at the front and back.
